title: creating a wonderland cottage home - why your interior space matters
en: hello everyone this week i wanted to share some of the progress i've been making in my new home i've been ever so slowly trying to find time outside of work to put things in place and organize i'm still a long ways away from getting things to where i'd like them to be however i have started my flower garden made plans for future tidying of the property and of course adopted more house plants because apparently
three dozen isn't enough i am currently working on painting the walls and so far it is taking forever but i hope to show you what i've been up to very soon at the end of this video i'm going to go

more into detail on how i transform my space using simple techniques and focus on second-hand repurposed and gifted items for a very unique look however i will say that changing your space doesn't necessarily mean bringing new items into your home instead before i make any decisions i like to focus on my senses usually that means sitting experiencing the space considering how i want to feel when i enter my home be that vibrant energetic or peaceful and tranquil a consideration for me is what my pets enjoy as well for example my cat and bunny like sunlight and quiet eiker loves classical music and rugs for the sense of sight i like to hang fascinators in my windows and all types

of fun little items made of glass that capture the sun rays and cast rainbows on the floor as well as curtains that filter the light i also think how a space smells has a conscious and subconscious effect on how we feel so i consider candles and diffusers to be important

in order to transform a normal piece of furniture and make it more unique i like to change the knobs as well as add little decorative accents for example this dining table is quite worn and i will be sanding it and painting it very soon stay tuned in the next week or two for a more or less completed house tour so you can see how the space is starting to come together and hopefully feel inspired to imbue your personality into where you live and really set free your creativity so
of course my house wouldn't feel complete if it wasn't for my pets and cozy evenings after work baking with them do
do do while my home is still not

absolutely 100 complete i did want to share at least what i have done and i also am going to share a completed home tour hopefully next week complete complete home tour because we are finally finally mostly complete with renovations so you also probably know from my past videos i am very passionate about budgeting and finances and simple living and frugality where possible and also taking into consideration sustainability so for me my answer my simple answer to bringing nature into consideration in regards to my space is to buy things secondhand

where possible for example this shirt it's a because i am an etsy shop owner i of course love to support other etsy shops that is something that's very important to me in order to help other businesses across the world i also try to purchase some items locally that i normally wouldn't get second hand for example i have a very hard time finding rugs secondhand that are not smelly a lot of rugs that are very old just have a smell that i can't get out of it no matter how many times they shampoo it so that is one thing i decided to get new but a lot of things even luke had a lot of furniture in his home some of it which i have sanded and repurposed and

painted i also wanted to have a very lovely hi baby eiger is here i don't think that there's any reason that anyone needs to go out and buy expensive items to transform their space and i think it comes down to for me at least some very basic principles that make a huge difference and those are in regards to your senses and for me whenever i am thinking about how i want to make a space more conducive to helping my anxiety helping me feel like my best self i think that so many videos i see focus so much on the visual appeal i love making videos that are all about visual beauty and nature and

a home life but i think that is perhaps the least important part in a way because i think how your space feels encompasses so much more than its aesthetic quality so one thing that i do always think about is sounds i like to hang up items such as soft wind chimes or have a little fountain running in my house that just sounds calming and brings me back to nature one of my favorite things is having a little water fountain music or ambient sounds into your space when you're there on a very very low level can really make a big difference i know some people just prefer complete silence in their homes but if you are someone that likes interesting nature

sounds you could take that into consideration and that can be involved into your home on a very low budget you know a small fountain where wind chime you know is pretty easy to do i also like hanging a bird feeder near my house so that i get a lot of birds coming nearby and all their sounds are always very appealing to me how your space smells is also very important for me especially because i have a lot of pets so it can smell like dog hair very quickly i love to use smokeless incense or oil or my preferred wishes usually a candle in order to make the space smell really fresh and nice and of course that goes hand in hand with sweeping and vacuuming but it is something that really makes a big

difference and smells do make a difference with how we feel what we smell really does impact us more than we think i also like hanging little glass fascinators on my window if i get direct light so that it can cast little rainbows on the ground it makes such a wonderful difference even if you have a space that's simple it just having that light come in in such an interesting way i always find really makes me happy i also really love to use little um decorative edges i don't know what they're called but i'll show some images of them but i love to use those little decorative edges in order to add something really interesting to a window or a corner in my kitchen it always makes such a difference it's very

specific to my style which is a little more old-fashioned and whimsical but i thought i would offer that as an option to you as well i love hanging things in my windows that are always interesting i love having plants having life in my space even if you don't get direct light you can use plant lights and just bring in so much life and loveliness in your space i hope this was somewhat interesting to you it's definitely a passion project for me i just love decorating and now what i'm gonna go ahead and do is try painting the walls a little bit with some fun designs and show you how strange lady i am that i want to paint birds on my wall so um yes

maybe if you are a little fairy at heart you may also want to imbue your space with some of this pixie dust but if not listen to your heart whatever works for you and whatever makes you feel comfortable it's not about things it's about the feeling you're looking for in your space i'm sending my love wishing you a wonderful week goodbye you

为了改造一件普通的家具并使其更加独特，我喜欢更换旋钮并添加一些装饰口音，例如这张餐桌已经很旧了，我很快就会对其进行打磨和喷漆，请在接下来的一两周内继续关注或多或少完成的房屋参观，这样您就可以看到空间是如何开始组合在一起的，并希望受到启发，将您的个性融入您居住的地方，并真正释放您的创造力，所以

在可能的情况下，例如这件衬衫，因为我是 etsy 店老板，我当然喜欢支持其他 etsy 商店，这对我来说非常重要，以便帮助世界各地的其他企业，我也尝试在当地购买一些我通常不会买到二手的物品，例如，我很难找到没有臭味的二手地毯，很多很旧的地毯只是有一种气味，无论他们洗多少次，我都无法摆脱它，所以这是我决定买新的一件事，但很多东西甚至卢克家里也有很多家具，其中一些我已经打磨过并重新调整了用途，
我也想有一个非常可爱的嗨宝贝艾格峰在这里，我不认为任何人需要出去购买昂贵的物品来改造他们的空间，我认为这对我来说至少有一些非常基本的原则，这些原则会产生巨大的影响，这些原则与你的感官有关，对我来说，每当我思考如何创造一个更有利于缓解焦虑的空间，帮助我感觉最好的自己时，我认为我看到的很多视频都非常关注我喜欢制作的视觉吸引力都是关于视觉美和自然的视频

家庭生活，但我认为这在某种程度上可能是最不重要的部分，因为我认为你的空间感觉不仅仅包括它的审美质量，所以我总是考虑的一件事是声音，我喜欢挂一些物品，比如柔和的风铃，或者在我的房子里放一个小喷泉，听起来很平静，让我回归自然，我最喜欢的事情之一是，当你在一个非常非常低的水平上时，在你的空间里放一点喷泉音乐或环境声音真的可以产生很大的不同，我知道有些人只是喜欢完整的他们家里很安静，但如果你是一个喜欢有趣的自然的人
听起来你可以考虑到这一点，并且可以以非常低的预算融入你的家你知道一个小喷泉，你知道风铃很容易做我也喜欢在我家附近挂一个喂鸟器，这样我附近就会有很多鸟，它们所有的声音总是对我很有吸引力你的空间气味对我来说也很重要，特别是因为我有很多宠物，所以它很快就会闻起来像狗毛我喜欢使用无烟香或油或者我的首选愿望通常是蜡烛让空间闻起来非常新鲜和好闻，当然，这与清扫和吸尘密切相关，但它确实能带来很大的好处

差异和气味确实会影响我们的感受，气味对我们的影响比我们想象的要大，我也喜欢在窗户上挂一些小玻璃饰物，如果我有直射光，这样它就可以在地面上投射出小彩虹，即使你有一个简单的空间，它也会产生如此美妙的差异，只是让光线以一种有趣的方式进入，我总是发现真的让我很高兴，我也很喜欢使用小装饰边缘，我不知道它们叫什么，但我会展示它们的一些图像但我喜欢使用这些小装饰边缘，以便在厨房的窗户或角落添加一些真正有趣的东西，它总是会产生如此大的差异，非常重要

具体到我的风格，有点老式和异想天开，但我想我也会提供给你作为一个选择，我喜欢在窗户上挂一些总是很有趣的东西，我喜欢在我的空间里种植有生命的植物，即使你没有直射光，你也可以使用植物灯，为你的空间带来如此多的生机和可爱，我希望这对你来说有点有趣，这对我来说绝对是一个充满激情的项目，我只是喜欢装饰，现在我要继续做的是尝试粉刷墙壁上有一些有趣的设计，并向你展示我是多么奇怪的女士，我想在我的墙上画鸟，所以嗯是的
也许如果你内心是个小仙女，你可能也想在你的空间中注入一些这种精灵灰尘，但如果不听从你的内心，无论什么对你有用，无论什么让你感到舒服，这不是关于事物，而是关于你在你的空间中寻找的感觉，我送上我的爱，祝你度过愉快的一周再见你
